name: actor-22-drug-safety-recalls-monitor
title: FDA openFDA + EMA DHPC - Drug Recall Delta Feed
description: Combines the FDA's openFDA drug enforcement API and the EMA's DHPC safety-alert feed into one normalized 18-field schema, tagged by jurisdiction and agency, sorted newest-first, with a mandatory regulatory-data disclaimer on every record. Delta mode flags status changes across scheduled runs.
